name: Best Western Plus Hotel Alpenrose
beschreibung: The Best Western Plus Hotel Alpenrose is a hotel in Kufstein in Tirol. The accommodation is centrally located and offers access to the city's sights. The property features comfortably furnished rooms and suites. A breakfast buffet is offered to guests. There is also a restaurant serving regional and international cuisine. Wellness facilities such as a sauna and fitness room complement the offering. Meeting rooms for business events are also available.
